There are exactly THREE candidate carriers on a PO line, a Bill line and a Journal line, and only ONE is common to all three: (1) tags[] {tag_id, tag_option_id} - available on PO line, Bill line AND Journal line, and enforceable via is_mandatory; (2) project_id - also available on all three lines, but limited to a flat customer-bound project; (3) item_custom_fields - available on PO and Bill lines but NOT on journal lines. Only reporting tags and project_id span all three documents.

records.limitation: ANSWERS DESIGN QUESTION (d), CONFIRMING the earlier probe. Self-referencing parent fields found in ERP master data: parent_account_id (Chart of Accounts), parent_location_id (Locations), parent_task_id/parent_id (standalone Tasks module - to-dos, not project WBS), parent_module_id (Custom Modules, module metadata not records). NOT found: any parent on Project, any parent on project task, any parent on Department. Therefore native ERP Projects gives 2 fixed levels only. An n-level WBS must be built on either (i) a Custom Module with a self-referencing lookup provisioned in the UI - the documented generic CRUD at /{module_name} then carries it, or (ii) the reporting-tag dimension with encoded hierarchical option codes, or (iii) parent_account_id on the Chart of Accounts if the WBS can be expressed as an account tree. Option (i) loses native project cost roll-up; option (ii) is flat with encoded depth; option (iii) conflates WBS with the GL.

gaps: OpenAPI bundle at https://www.zoho.com/erp/api/v3/openapi-all.zip exists and was NOT downloaded (file downloads require explicit user approval). Obtaining it would resolve every field-shape ambiguity below in one step. This also contradicts the source-routing brief's claim that no OpenAPI artifact exists for ERP.

Departments: the page sits at /erp/api/v3/departments/ but every runnable example targets /erp/v1/departments. Which base path actually serves Departments is unverified and must be probed against a live org.

There is NO endpoint anywhere in the ERP v3 API to create, list or describe a CUSTOM FIELD DEFINITION. Custom fields must be provisioned through the UI, so the WBS/CAPEX field layout cannot be deployed as code.

Line-item custom field payload shape differs across modules (PO: customfield_id+value; Bills: custom_field_id+index+value+label; Sales Order: customfield_id+index). Unverified whether the API accepts all shapes interchangeably.

Purchase Order header-level custom_fields carries the same description text as item_custom_fields ('Custom fields for purchase order line item'), so header vs line semantics on a PO are ambiguous in the docs.
Tasks module request tables use is_sub_task/parent_id while response tables use is_subtask/parent_task_id. Which key the API actually accepts on write is unverified.

Tasks dependencies use integer codes (dependency_type, depends_on_entity_type); the code tables are not published. related_entity_type allowed values are also unpublished (only the example value 'invoice' is shown).

Recursion depth of parent_task_id (Tasks), parent_location_id (Locations) and parent_account_id (Chart of Accounts) is nowhere stated. Whether these support arbitrary depth or a fixed number of levels is unverified.
Contacts custom_fields index is documented as 1 to 10. Whether 10 is a hard ceiling on addressable custom fields is unverified.
No list endpoint exists for tax groups (GET /settings/taxgroups is absent) and no org-wide list exists for contact persons or exchange rates.

Pagination parameters are not restated on the Locations, Contact Persons, Time Entries, Reporting Tags, Registers or Tasks list sections; whether the global 200-default contract applies there is unverified.

Reporting tag 'preference' is set once per tag for the whole multi_preference_entities node. Whether one tag can be transaction-level for journals and line-level for purchases simultaneously is unverified and the doc wording implies it cannot.

No budget object keyed to project_id exists; budget-vs-actuals is keyed on account_id only. Project-level budget is limited to the scalar fields budget_type, budget_amount and cost_budget_amount on the project itself.

ERP.department.*, ERP.fixedasset.* and ERP.custommodules.* are used on module pages but are missing from the master scope table on /erp/api/v3/oauth/. Whether these scopes are grantable in the Developer Console is unverified.
No SAP or Fiori sources were researched in this lane - R11 scope was Zoho ERP master data only, so rule 7 (SAP IP) had no application and no ux_pattern records were produced.
